outcome: Delayed child development at age 3 years (measured by the modified Parents' Evaluation of Developmental Status (M-PEDS) and a shortened Ages and Stages Questionnaire (S-ASQ))
cohort: First-time mothers and their offspring in Pennsylvania (695 children born by cesarean delivery and 1676 born vaginally)
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an elevated risk of delayed child development at age 3 years.
